scope: Source-only panel lifecycle audit and unwired host-testable transport. No physical writes, native registration, QEMU model changes or kernel integration.

sequence: axs_reset_proc(20) resets touch as part of panel initialization
normal_resume.warning: Bias programming/reset/panel wake are not independent from touch lifecycle. No native implementation or rollback is admitted.

proximity_branch.suspend: If proximity flag nonzero, sets is_in_sleepmode0 and returns without DCS sleep or bias-off.
proximity_branch.resume: Only if proximity flag nonzero and is_in_sleepmode!=1, sends1100 delay150ms then2900 delay20ms.
proximity_branch.warning: This branch does NOT prove the same table is a safe resume after sleep commands with retained bias. Stock had skipped sleep in the corresponding suspend branch.

gpio_mapping.dt_enn_and_enp: Both overlay ENP and ENN low/high names map GPIO150; do not infer two independent rail enable pins.
gpio_mapping.limit: Static overlay routing; live pin state and electrical rail topology unverified. BSP enum differs (11entries), so stock indices were decoded from stock pointer table.

host_suspend_order.conclusion: Normal stock panel suspend occurs after host path stop in command mode. Sending sleep commands while inherited video scanout stays active is not corroborated by this normal path.

video_command_transport.packet: DSI_set_cmdq_V2 short branch0xffffff80087758b8 encodes DCS one-parameter ID0x15, command bits16..23, parameter bits24..31, LONG_PKT0; VM_CMD_CON offset0x130.
video_command_transport.setup: DSI_Set_VM_CMD0xffffff8008771cfc sets VM_CMD_EN0 and TS_VFP_EN5. Prototype requires these already configured, VFP-only timing, sync-event video mode2.
video_command_transport.trigger: DSI_EnableVM_CMD0xffffff8008772108, direct path0xffffff8008772274..22d0 toggles START bit16 low then high preserving other bits.
video_command_transport.completion: INTSTA0x0c bit5 VM_CMD_DONE; BSP GCE path clears/polls/clears that bit. Host prototype requires observed low then high and bounded timeout.
video_command_transport.acknowledgement: Exact stock disp_irq_handler0xffffff8008799b24 complements selected status then stores to DSI+0xc at0xffffff8008799b3c; W0C. Prototype writes literal~0x20 to preserve unrelated status.
exclusions: No enabling VM facility, mode transitions, clock/PLL/lane programming or interrupt-mask writes.
No command-mode, BTA/read, long vendor commands, arbitrary payloads or dual DSI.
No automatic retry or reset after unknown completion; failure latches terminal state.
Completion proves controller command completion, not panel acknowledgement or physical sleep.
video_command_transport.initial_idle_admission: Exclusive ownership alone is insufficient. The required admit_initial_idle callback must establish a previously verified idle handoff/drain independently; no physical proof implementation is supplied. Initial START16 high is always rejected before writes, irrespective of stale DONE. START16 low alone never proves idle.
video_command_transport.retained_trigger: A high START16 is accepted only for this transport own command after observed fresh DONE, unchanged packet/mode and final W0C acknowledgement readback low. Subsequent calls reject changed packet content or unexpectedly reasserted DONE; faults invalidate the completion token.
video_command_transport.final_ack: Read back INTSTA after final W0C. DONE still high or errors fail and latch fault; no success or subsequent command is allowed.

integration_plan: Keep committed PWM/copy blanking as current working lifecycle until a separate panel ownership contract is admitted.

Transfer exclusive DSI/GCE command queue and IRQ-acknowledgement ownership; prove no bootloader/SSPM/ESD worker can reset or submit commands concurrently. Read back clocks/domain/PLL/lane/timing/reset/bias state before each operation.
Use the unwired video short-command core only for separately admitted VM command operation. It is not an automatic panel-sleep policy.

For exact normal stock sleep, implement and validate host quiesce: stop producers/GCE at frame boundary, drain fences, stop display path, transition DSI to command mode and verify idle before panel commands. Retain clocks needed for command transport; do not power gate by guessed writes.

After exact DCS delays, normal stock cuts GPIO150 bias; doing so requires verified pin/bias rail ownership and explicit touch contact release/quiesce. Resume needs exact bias, AXS reset, panel reset and full vendor init before restoring scanout/backlight.
Alternatively, a retained-bias/retained-scanout sleep design requires new proof specific to this panel; the proximity branch is insufficient.

Validate completion/fault paths and actual panel state/readback before MiniFB wiring. Any partial command/rail failure leaves backlight off and state unknown, requiring a deliberate proven recovery path.
unresolved: Safe native display pipeline quiesce/resume order and ownership transfer.
DSI IRQ/GCE command acknowledgement ownership and inherited VM scheduling availability.
Bias pin/rail electrical verification, shared touch reset coordination and cold power lifecycle.
Panel state verification; VM command-done alone does not acknowledge the panel.
Safe physical timing and failure recovery.
Physical initial-idle admission/drain proof; ownership transfer or START low cannot substitute.

validation.host_test: test_dsi_vm.c compiled with C11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror; all display-touch tests pass.
covered: All four short DCS packet encodings
Only VM START16 toggles; DSI_START0 and unrelated fields preserved
Other one-shot START bits2/4 rejected before any writes
W0C preserves old and newly arriving unrelated status flags
Observed low before trigger; stale-high rejected
Ownership/mode/config errors reject or latch fault
No native registration or MMIO execution
Inherited high START rejected with DONE high and low, zero writes
Low START rejected without independent initial idle admission
Own completed trigger may be retained for the next command only after final acknowledgement
Dropped final acknowledgement fails without creating a completion token; retries denied
Changed prior packet or reasserted DONE invalidates retained completion proof
